_contract: REGISTERED BEFORE ANY SESSION. Stage L of topk_adoption_driver.py: D3's lambda (lambda rule v2), the diagnostic thresholds (diagnostic_threshold_rule), the rollout-rescoring cost, the D2 objective's overhead on the production state-evaluation and DEPTH paths, the GPU evidence for the reference-cache fix, and two equivalence checks -- cached vs recomputed references, and the D2 objective under scored_v1 vs all_v1. No D2 candidate exists when it runs and none is created; no D2 score table or choice is recorded. AUTHORIZES NOTHING by itself: authorization.json does.

version_history.change: maintainer grant shape $1.76 / $1.42 (post-48fcc638 review); cache evidence before/after the probe, hits/fills/recomputes; cached-vs-recomputed and D2 scored-rows equivalence steps; evidence booked by sha256

question: on the standing incumbent B against the teacher: what are lambda and the registered diagnostic thresholds; what does the D2 objective add to a state evaluation and to one DEPTH round; does the reference cache stay cached under a hoarded allocator after the fix; are cached and recomputed references the same numbers; is the D2 objective under scored_v1 equivalent to all_v1?
order: after R0's session has closed and been reviewed
prediction_rows: all_v1 for every base measurement -- the mode D2 runs until D2's own scored-rows equivalence passes; the scored_v1 arms are internal comparisons
sequence: check-only preflight on the pod: B's identities and $0 construction gate, the registered pool, the policy, both rule hashes, the contract
rebuild B (A_bsz1, all four identities), the GPU to itself
teacher and B over the 147 unique items -> lambda and thresholds; rescoring timed on 24 items
then the steps below, each only when the deadline covers its bound (an extended step: also every core bound still to come)

step_contents.state_eval: B: KL-only, D2 objective, KL-only again (all_v1); D2 overhead per evaluation; raw-KL control vs D1's KL metrics
step_contents.d2_rows_state_eval: B: D2 objective under scored_v1 vs the all_v1 values
step_contents.depth_one_round: one DEPTH round at the root, KL-only then D2, each under a deliberately hoarded allocator: memory before/after the probe, sketch estimate, admission, hits/fills/recomputes, wall time, peak memory; overhead per candidate; cache_fix_validated
step_contents.depth_recompute_equivalence: KL-only DEPTH round forced to recompute, vs the cached KL-only table (D1-path evidence)
step_contents.d2_rows_depth: D2 DEPTH round under scored_v1 vs the all_v1 D2 arm: agreement statistics only, never the table or choice

tolerances._source: R0's registered KL tolerances, carried over; cache equivalence exact because the code claims identical numbers

never_records: the D2 objective's DEPTH table or choice: nothing that looks like a D2 search result may exist before D2's search

acceptance.calibration: lambda_from_reference returns a value and the pool is the registered 209 draws / 147 unique items
acceptance.cache_fix: cache_fix_validated: both hoarded arms entered with < 1 GiB driver-free and > 1 GiB hoarded, the probe freed at least the sketch, the reference CACHED with 0 recomputes and > 0 fills. One root profile proves the mechanism, not every future expansion; the D2 search keeps recording cache modes
acceptance.d2_scored_rows: PASS only if both D2 comparisons ran and are within tolerance; otherwise D2 runs all_v1
acceptance.everything_else: diagnostic: a skipped or failed step is recorded and the dependent price stays provisional

evidence_booking: the closeout commits this session's adoption.json and books it in campaign.json subruns as evidence_session + evidence_session_sha256; d2_budget.py reads stage-L evidence through that booking only, verifies the hash and the identities, and switches the D2 search price only then

hardware._peak_from: a3 stage D; stage P peaked at 16.29 GiB (a8). A 24 GB card is too tight

time_and_money._cap_vs_bill: the cap sets the ssh window (cap / live rate); the watchdog stops the pod 12 min after it, so the worst bill can exceed the cap -- the grant's $0.30 reserve covers it, inside the grant
